title: Passover and the Cloud

questions.question: When was the Passover celebrated in the wilderness of Sinai?
options: The first month of the second year
questions.correctAnswer: The first month of the second year
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:1 (ESV): "...in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Why could some men not keep the Passover?
options: They were unclean through touching a dead body
questions.correctAnswer: They were unclean through touching a dead body
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:6 (ESV): "And there were certain men who were unclean through touching a dead body, so that they could not keep the Passover."

questions.question: When was the "Second Passover" allowed for those unclean or on a journey?
options: Fourteenth day of the second month
Fourteenth day of the first month
Fifteenth day of the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: Fourteenth day of the second month
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:11 (ESV): "In the second month on the fourteenth day at twilight they shall keep it."

questions.question: What appeared over the tabernacle on the day it was set up?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:15 (ESV): "On the day that the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle..."

questions.question: How did the appearance change at night?
options: It was like the appearance of fire
questions.correctAnswer: It was like the appearance of fire
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:15 (ESV): "And at evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning."

questions.question: When did the people of Israel set out?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:17 (ESV): "And whenever the cloud lifted from over the tent, after that the people of Israel set out..."

questions.question: If the cloud remained for many days, what did the people do?
options: They kept the charge of the Lord and did not set out
questions.correctAnswer: They kept the charge of the Lord and did not set out
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:19 (ESV): "Then the people of Israel kept the charge of the Lord and did not set out."

questions.question: Could a sojourner/stranger keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:14 (ESV): "And if a stranger sojourns among you and would keep the Passover... he shall do so according to the statute..."

questions.question: What is the punishment for a clean person who fails to keep the Passover?
options: That person shall be cut off from his people
questions.correctAnswer: That person shall be cut off from his people
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:13 (ESV): "But if any man who is clean... fails to keep the Passover, that person shall be cut off from his people."

questions.question: Who determined when they camped or set out?
options: The command of the Lord by Moses
questions.correctAnswer: The command of the Lord by Moses
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:23 (ESV): "At the command of the Lord they camped, and at the command of the Lord they set out."

questions.question: What were the rules for eating the Passover lamb mentioned here?
options: Eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs; leave none until morning; break no bone
questions.correctAnswer: Eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs; leave none until morning; break no bone
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:11-12 recalls these rules: "Eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break any of its bones."

questions.question: Did the cloud ever stay from evening only until morning?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:21 (ESV): "Sometimes the cloud remained from evening until morning..."

questions.question: Who brought the question of the unclean men to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:8 (ESV): "And Moses said to them, 'Wait, that I may hear what the Lord will command concerning you.'"

questions.question: What phrase is used to describe the tabernacle in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:15 (ESV): "The cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony."

questions.question: How long did the cloud rest over the tabernacle (maximum duration mentioned)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 9:22 (ESV): "Whether... two days, or a month, or a longer time (Hebrew often implies a year)..."

key_verse_text: And whenever the cloud lifted from over the tent, after that the people of Israel set out, and in the place where the cloud settled down, there the people of Israel camped.
